acceptance: Every output passes complete untimed paragraph/run/membership oracle and timed archive hash/bytes/counters. All 12 lanes retained with source/build identity and all individual normal repeat flags above5percent. Stable incremental allocator peak across sizes and zero exitdelta support only tested scoped bounded-memory observation; if peak grows, investigate and do not substitute modeled scratch.
limits: No logical append, Part addition, arbitrary edits/repackaging, native Office, broad-format feature, source-variant or worker-scaling proof. Full-process RSS includes materializing preflight; no RSS causality claim.
memory_scope: Allocator target callback-order operation requested-heap peak minus entry and live exit minus entry, including writer/helper/context/transport allocations and other process threads. Excludes allocator-internal realloc overlap, physical copies, RSS and retained preflight. 64-byte semantic scratch and zero retained sink output are separate properties.
scope: Descriptive fresh plain DOCX paragraph creation only; no before/after production or registered latency claim.
timing_scope: Writer helper context/limits construction, deterministic paragraph text generation, public writer new/start/write/finish, Deflate/ZIP finalization and writer/context destruction. Sink construction and digest extraction, process/allocator boundary reads, materialized preflight and reopen are excluded.
